trades.thesis: Post-earnings capitulation (-27% on 10/29 on cRPO guide 18.5% vs ~19.5% Street, first EPS miss) has based for 4 sessions at 106-112, up 3% Tuesday, with software swept by AI-disruption fear that looks overdone given AI ACV +65% and a raised $1.7B target. Broad tech stabilising (XLK +1.3%, futures up after midterms removed political risk). Small size because the sector trend is still unproven and negative post-earnings drift is a real risk.
